query:
select
registration_date as "Registration date",
total_patient_registrations as "Total patient registrations",
total_birth_registrations as "Total birth registrations",
total_incorrect_registrations_for_patient_under_6mth as "Total incorrect registrations for aged under 6 months"
from "reporting"."ds__usage_quality_metrics_patient_registrations"
where
registration_date >= 
:fromDate
and
registration_date <= 
:toDate
name: Usage quality metrics - patient registrations
notes: This report generates usage quality metrics on patient registrations. The report provides a summary by selected date range on the total new patient registrations, total birth registrations, and total incorrect registrations (patient instead of birth) for under 6 months old.
